components.name: HeadlineStrips
components.when_to_use: Any beat whose main job is the big text: each line on its own torn paper strip, accent line in the accent colour. Max 3 lines, 4 words per line.

components.name: Tag
components.when_to_use: A short label (place, year, who, 'लोककथा') on a taped paper tag.

components.name: Stamp
components.when_to_use: One strong word slammed on like a rubber stamp (impact beat: shakes the camera).

components.name: Note
components.when_to_use: A handwritten margin note (Kalam) on a sticky of paper, with a marker underline: a human aside or a 'so what'.

components.name: Typewriter
components.when_to_use: A line typed out letter by letter on a manuscript card: a question, a record entry or the closing hook.

components.name: QuoteCard
components.when_to_use: A quoted line with its attribution ('शिव पुराण के अनुसार', 'लोग कहते हैं') on a manuscript card. Use for any claim that rests on a source or a legend.

components.name: Counter
components.when_to_use: One big number that rolls up from zero, with its label. The number must appear in the script.

components.name: Checklist
components.when_to_use: 2-3 rows on a ruled card, each ticked, crossed or struck out: options, who passed or failed, step by step. Prefix a row '+ ' tick, '- ' cross, '~ ' strike.

components.name: Cutout
components.when_to_use: One illustrated subject as a sticker cut-out (white border, hard shadow) entering by slide, rise, pop, fly or drop. The workhorse visual.

components.name: MarkerDraw
components.when_to_use: A red marker circle or underline drawn on to point at the hero (works on top of a Cutout; also used by motion preset 'circle').

components.name: UniversalFallback
components.when_to_use: When nothing in the catalog fits: headline strips + one cutout + a motion preset. Always valid. Using it logs a 'gap' so the missing component lands on the backlog.

components.name: BigWords
components.when_to_use: Minimal typographic: one huge word at a time slammed on the screen (on black in the minimal style), the payoff word in the accent colour. Almost no imagery; the sound does the work.

components.name: Parallax
components.when_to_use: 2.5D: the camera pushes through 2-3 layers (background, middle, foreground) that move at different speeds, like a film shot. Give assets back to front.

components.name: Flashlight
components.when_to_use: Spotlight reveal: a dark scene where a flashlight beam sweeps and uncovers the hidden lines, then opens to the whole truth. Mystery re-hooks and verdicts.

components.name: ShapeHero
components.when_to_use: A big flat shape (circle, moon, eye, drop, diamond, heart, coin) with a short label: the thing the next scene's match cut flows out of. Set beat.shapes = [this shape, next shape].

components.name: VersusSplit
components.when_to_use: Split screen: two panels side by side (left vs right) with a VS badge: comparisons, then vs now, two theories. Give two assets and two labels.

components.name: Grid4
components.when_to_use: Four-panel mosaic (2x2) with staggered pops: four clues, four theories, four steps. Up to 4 assets and 3-4 short labels.

components.name: BeforeAfter
components.when_to_use: Before / after: one frame where a divider sweeps across and reveals the second image. Two assets (before, after) and two labels.

components.name: CardFlip
components.when_to_use: 3D-lite: a card flips in 3D to reveal the answer on its back. Front = picture + question, back = the answer.

components.name: Spin3D
components.when_to_use: 3D-lite: a 4-sided prism rotates in 3D showing up to 4 faces (a list, 'top 4', four facts). Faces are labels or assets.

components.name: Text3D
components.when_to_use: 3D-lite: one extruded 3D word that tilts and sways in perspective. Use for the single most important word or number.

components.name: SearchWindow
components.when_to_use: Investigation desktop: a newspaper-archive search box types the query, then results pop in and the first one is highlighted. First on_screen item = the query, the others = the result headlines.

components.name: ChatThread
components.when_to_use: Investigation desktop: chat bubbles pop in one by one (alternating sides, a typing indicator first): witness messages, an exchange of letters, a theory thread. Up to 3 messages.

components.name: FileFolders
components.when_to_use: Investigation desktop: 2-3 case-file folders slide in with labels, the last one is stamped CASE OPEN. Labels = names, places or years.

components.name: RedactedDoc
components.when_to_use: A classified-looking document: filler lines are blacked out, then black bars wipe away one by one to reveal the key lines. Up to 3 reveal lines.

components.name: MapFlight
components.when_to_use: Map flight: a globe spins to the place, zooms through country to the spot, and drops a pin with coordinates (d3-geo + Natural Earth outlines, drawn per frame). Give the place name, lat/lon and the country name as in Natural Earth.

components.name: Footage
components.when_to_use: A full-bleed graded photographic plate with a slow camera move, a small kicker (place/date) and an honest label: ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION for generated images, ARCHIVE only for verified real material. Optional amber highlight box on the exact thing being discussed.

components.name: Timeline
components.when_to_use: Evidence timeline: 2-4 dated nodes reveal down a vertical line (year in amber, what happened in ivory). Use only dates stated in the script; prefix a node with '!' to mark a crisis in red.

components.name: ChoiceTree
components.when_to_use: Choice architecture: a question branches into 3-4 options; the DEFAULT option is the one made easy, visible and first. The branches draw, then the default path lights amber while the others dim.

components.name: Specimen
components.when_to_use: THE signature visual: one engraved cut-out taped onto a paper mount like a museum specimen, with a typewritten label card under it (tag, title, small caption). Use it for the object or place the narration is talking about. on_screen = [title, caption]; beat.tag = the small red tag (SPECIMEN, ARTEFACT, EXHIBIT A ...).

components.name: StringBoard
components.when_to_use: Evidence board: 2-3 cut-outs pinned on index cards and joined by a red thread that draws from one to the next: 'it was all connected / someone arranged this'. Give 2-3 assets and a short label for each (on_screen).

components.name: SwapDemo
components.when_to_use: A swap: two pictures trade places (what you chose vs what you got). Placed by the smart picker, never by the Director.

components.name: DotCrowd
components.when_to_use: A share of people (a percent or a fraction): 100 small figures, n of them lit. Placed by the smart picker from the narration's own number.

components.name: RedactReveal
components.when_to_use: A sentence on paper with key words covered by black bars that wipe away. Placed by the smart picker.

components.name: Contrast
components.when_to_use: What you assumed versus what actually happened: two stacked cards (light then dark). Placed by the smart picker.

components.name: Narrator
components.when_to_use: The theme's mascot character says one line from a note; use once per video for the named effect or the reveal. Placed by the smart picker.

components.name: HighlightText
components.when_to_use: A statement with key words highlighted in sequence. Placed by the smart picker.

styles.name: caseboard
styles.label: Case board (evidence wall)
styles.looks: Dark cork wall, polaroid-style photos pinned with red thread, case-file numbers.
styles.best_for: Who arranged this? Connections between people, places, events
styles.how_built: CSS cork texture, torn polaroid mounts, red thread (StringBoard), hard cuts and tape rips.

styles.name: surveillance
styles.label: Surveillance log (being observed)
styles.looks: Black-and-green CCTV frames with scan lines, corner brackets, camera numbers and timecodes.
styles.best_for: Tracking, attention, feeds, notifications: someone is watching what you do
styles.how_built: CSS scan lines + vignette, monitor-frame mounts, mono timecode labels.

styles.name: clinical
styles.label: Clinical experiment
styles.looks: Cold slate lab page with graph paper, ruler ticks, subject numbers and figure labels.
styles.best_for: Documented experiments and studies: what researchers saw people do
styles.how_built: CSS graph paper and rulers, white specimen mounts, teal accents.

styles.name: noir
styles.label: Price-tag noir (persuasion)
styles.looks: Black and gold, diagonal hairlines, checker edge, item numbers: the shop as a stage.
styles.best_for: Pricing, anchoring, subscriptions, offers and bait
styles.how_built: CSS hairline pattern, checker strip, cream tag mounts with gold accents.

styles.name: specimen
styles.label: Specimen file (dark psychology)
styles.looks: Dark aged paper with a grid, taped engraved cut-outs, typewriter labels, option cards with struck-out choices, red stamps and red thread: someone arranged these choices for you.
styles.best_for: Dark-psychology and invisible-systems explainers; mystery and true-crime hooks
styles.how_built: Code-drawn paper, tape and labels; generated cut-outs (Klein + BiRefNet); hard cuts and tape-rip transitions; dark vignette and light grain.

styles.name: documentary
styles.label: Investigative documentary
styles.looks: Graded photographic plates with slow camera moves, evidence timelines, choice trees, calm dissolves, restrained captions.
styles.best_for: Invisible-systems explainers: habits, pricing, history of customs, behavioural experiments
styles.how_built: Pre-graded plates (Ken Burns) + code-drawn motion graphics + dissolves; light vignette; continuous narration with forced-alignment captions.

styles.name: scrapbook
styles.label: Grunge scrapbook
styles.looks: Torn paper, ink splashes, marker lines, tape-rip transitions, fast jump edits.
styles.how_built: Torn clip-path pieces + hard cuts; tape-rip and flash transitions.

styles.name: kinetic
styles.label: Kinetic captions
styles.looks: Word-by-word Hindi captions with pops and colour on the keyword.
styles.best_for: Every video, on top of any style
styles.how_built: Word timestamps (forced alignment) drive the caption animation.

styles.name: parallax
styles.label: 2.5D parallax
styles.looks: A still image comes alive: the camera pushes through foreground and background layers like a film shot.
styles.how_built: Layered cut-outs (or an image + depth map) moved at different speeds in CSS 3D.

styles.name: zoomthrough
styles.label: Zoom-through transitions
styles.looks: Zoom into an object and the next scene emerges from inside it.
styles.how_built: Scale the scene into an element's position, then cross-fade to the next scene.

styles.name: matchcut
styles.label: Match cuts / shape morph
styles.looks: A circle becomes the moon, then a bubble, then a coin: scenes flow by shape.

styles.name: desktop
styles.label: Investigation desktop
styles.looks: The story told through a fake screen: archive search, file folders, chat bubbles, maps, redacted documents.
styles.how_built: HTML UI mockups with typing, scrolling and window pops.

styles.name: mapflight
styles.label: Map flights
styles.looks: Globe, country, city, pin with coordinates, Google-Earth style.
styles.how_built: d3-geo orthographic globe with GeoJSON outlines.

styles.name: retro
styles.label: Retro film / VHS / Super 8
styles.looks: Grain, gate weave, light leaks, film burns, timestamp overlay.
styles.how_built: Pre-baked grain + deterministic jitter; light leaks on cuts.

styles.name: threed
styles.label: 3D-lite
styles.looks: Rotating 3D objects, card flips, 3D text, low-poly props mixed with 2D.

styles.name: split
styles.label: Split screen / grids
styles.looks: Side by side, before and after, or four-panel mosaics.
styles.how_built: CSS grid layouts with staggered entrances.

styles.name: minimal
styles.label: Minimal typographic
styles.looks: Big words on black with strong sound design and almost no imagery.
styles.how_built: Text and timing only; the cheapest to make.

styles.name: whip
styles.label: Speed-ramp whip cuts
styles.looks: Hard cuts with motion blur, speed ramps and impact shakes. Fast and punchy.
styles.how_built: Blur on fast moves, shake on impacts.

styles.name: spotlight
styles.label: Spotlight / redaction reveals
styles.looks: A flashlight beam or black bars wipe away to reveal text.
styles.how_built: A radial mask or bar wipes.

transitions.name: glitch
transitions.desc: digital glitch: jittering slices and a hard switch

transitions.name: zoomThrough
transitions.desc: zoom into the focus point, next scene emerges from inside it

transitions.name: tapeRip
transitions.desc: a strip of torn paper sweeps across and tears the scene away

transitions.name: morphIris
transitions.desc: a shape grows and morphs into the next shape, revealing the next scene (match cut)

transitions.name: filmBurn
transitions.desc: orange film burn / light leak between scenes

transitions.name: spotlight
transitions.desc: radial mask closes to black, reopens on the next scene
